title: Euler core terms
description: Terms every Euler evaluation can use: reference inputs, the scored domain, spatial reconciliation of prediction and GT, and the generic reducers.

reference.gt.label: GT
reference.gt.description: The ground truth the prediction is scored against.

reference.calibration.label: calibration
reference.calibration.description: Camera calibration the evaluation reads (intrinsics for normals, radial/planar depth conversion).

reference.segmentation.label: GT segmentation
reference.segmentation.description: GT semantic segmentation; read for GT sky masking and sky IoU only.

reference.intrinsics.label: intrinsics
reference.intrinsics.description: Per-frame camera intrinsics (sparse lidar projection, point maps).

reference.camera_extrinsics.label: camera extrinsics
reference.camera_extrinsics.description: Camera poses used to project sparse GT.

reference.lidar_extrinsics.label: lidar extrinsics
reference.lidar_extrinsics.description: Lidar-to-camera transforms used to project sparse GT.

reference.input.label: input image
reference.input.description: The (degraded) RGB input the prediction restores; the reference of input-referenced metrics.

reference.depth.label: GT depth
reference.depth.description: GT depth an RGB evaluation reads for its depth-binned metrics.

domain.region.label: domain
domain.region.description: The region of the source frame that was scored, as {frame, box: [top, left, height, width]} in source pixels.

domain.grid.label: evaluated grid
domain.grid.description: [height, width] of the grid the metrics were computed on.

prediction.resample.label: prediction resampled
prediction.resample.description: Factor [height, width] by which the prediction was resampled onto the evaluated grid (target / source); [1, 1] when it was not.

spatial.gt_resample.label: GT resampled
spatial.gt_resample.description: Factor [height, width] by which the GT was resampled onto the prediction grid (target / source); [1, 1] when it was not. Resampled GT is different GT.

spatial.method.label: spatial alignment
spatial.method.description: How prediction and GT resolutions were reconciled (none, crop, vae_crop, resize_prediction, resize, warp_prediction, warp, pointcloud_projection). Compared through the keys it is derived from.

spatial.policy.label: spatial alignment policy
spatial.policy.description: The configured policy that chose the spatial method (e.g. auto, crop, resize, source_grid).

spatial.resize_target.label: resize target
spatial.resize_target.description: Which grid is resampled when resolutions differ and the prediction is not a crop: gt_grid (prediction onto GT) or prediction_grid (GT onto prediction).

spatial.mask_resample.label: mask resampling
spatial.mask_resample.description: Interpolation used to resample masks (nearest, nearest_exact).

core.seed.label: seed
core.seed.description: Random seed of stochastic parts of the evaluation.

image_mean.label: image mean
image_mean.description: Arithmetic mean of the per-image values.

pixel_pool.label: pixel pool
pixel_pool.description: Every valid pixel of every image pooled into one population; recomputed from per-image values with the metric's pool form and weight.

dataset.label: dataset
dataset.description: A dataset-level statistic that cannot be recomputed from per-item values (e.g. FID).
